aarti.pad1: Mother Śailaputrī, you ride a bull; the gods hail you with cries of victory. You are Bhavānī, beloved of Śiva; no one has known your glory. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You are Pārvatī, you are called Umā; whoever remembers you finds happiness. You grant ṛddhi and siddhi, prosperity and accomplishment; you show mercy and make one wealthy. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Whoever on a Monday, O beloved companion of Śiva, has performed your āratī: fulfil all his hopes, and wipe away all his sorrows and hardships. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Lighting a beautiful lamp of ghee and offering a dried coconut, chant the mantras with faith and feeling, then bow your head with love. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Victory to you, Ambā, young daughter of the king of mountains; Ambā, the cakorī bird to the moon of Śiva's face. Fulfil the heart's desire; fill Chaman always with happiness and wealth. ॥5॥
